༄༅/ /gzhan stong snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/'dir theg pa chen po nges don gyi dbu ma'i ngo bo ngos gzung bar bya ste/grub mtha'i rnam ga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhan stong snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ 'dir theg pa chen po nges don gyi dbu ma'i ngo bo ngos gzung bar bya ste/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang*/ dbu ma'i rnam gzhag ngos bzung ba dang*/ de la gzhan gyis brtags pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan sde mu stegs byed kyi lta grub ni thar ba'i lam dang bral ba yin la/ rang sde sangs rgyas pa'i lta grub ni thar pa'i lam dang 'brel ba yin no/ /mu stegs pa la thar lam med kyang*/ mtho ris kyi mngon par mtho ba'i chos ni yod med gnyis te/ rgyang 'phen pa sogs med par lta ba can las 'bras la skur ba 'debs pa sogs dang*/ 'tshe ba chos kyi gtso bor smra ba rnams la mtho ris kyi lam rnam dag med cing*/ grangs can pa dang*/ gcer bu pa dang*/ lha'i mchog gi rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig dang*/ mu stegs bsam gtan pa rnams la ni mtho ris kyi lam ni yod de/ sdig pa spong zhing dge ba bsgrubs pas mi dang 'dod khams pa'i lhar skye zhing*/ bsam gtan bzhi bsgoms pas gzugs khams su skye ba dang*/ gzugs med kyi ting 'dzin bzhi bsgoms pas gzugs med khams su skye bas so/ /mu stegs rnams la thar lam med pa'i rgyun mtshan ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin ces bya ba/ nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo 'di spong par mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa'i nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo brtan po yod pa'i steng du/ grub mthas kyang*/ nga bdag de nyid khyad par mang po dang bcas te yod par bsgrub cing*/ de'i don bsgom pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin de la gnyen po gzhan yang med pa'i phyir bdag 'dzin spong mi nus shing*/ bdag 'dzin de ni nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyi yang rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mu stegs bzang ba de rnams la skye rga na 'chi sogs mi rtag pa rags pa bsgom pa dang*/ tshe 'di dang 'dod khams sdug bsngal du shes pa dang*/

gzugs sogs dngos po rags pa rnams bden med du 'dod pa dang 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang*/ byams snying rje dang*/ dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i btang snyoms sogs dang*/ rtsa ba bzhi spong ba sogs lta sgom spyod pa legs po yang yod pas mtho ris kyi lam ni yod do// //sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde ba dang*/ sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'o/ /de la dang po gnyis ni theg dman nyan thos pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis ni theg chen pa'o/ /de rnams la theg pa che chung du 'jog pa yang theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod sangs rgyas kyi bka'i mthar thug tu 'dod pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i gsung rab sde snod rnams bka'i mthar thug tu 'dod pas de ltar btags pa yin pas/ theg dman smra ba dang theg chen smra ba zhes bya ba'i grub mtha' theg dman pa dang*/ grub mtha' theg chen pa zhes grags pa ltar yin la/ gang zag de nyid theg chung ngam theg chen par 'jog pa la ni grub mtha' la mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi bsam sbyor rgyud la skyes pa ni theg chen pa yin la/ theg dman gyi bsam sbyor rgyud la skyes pa ni theg dman pa yin zhing*/ de gnyis gang yang rgyud la ma skyes na/ gsung rab gang klog gzhung ci bzung grub mtha' ji ltar byed kyang gang zag theg chen pa yang ma yin gang zag theg dman pa yang ma yin no/ /gzhan yang grub mtha' theg chen 'dzin la/ lam theg dman du zhugs pa yang yod/ grub mtha' theg dman 'dzin la lam theg chen du zhugs pa yang yod/ gnyis ka theg chen pa yang yod gnyis ka theg dman pa'ang yod/ grub mtha' 'dzin cing lam du ma zhugs pa ni shin tu yang mang la/ lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag la grub mtha' med pa ni ye mi srid do/ /de dag las bye brag tu smra ba ni/ shes pa sems sems byung gnyis/ yul gzugs sogs bcu/ skye 'jig sogs ldan min 'du byed/

nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas gsum dang*/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi dngos po rnams rang rang so so nas rdzas su grub par 'dod cing bden grub kyi cha re yang yod par 'dod la/ rags pa'i dngos po dang rgyun gyi dngos po sogs ni bden med du 'dod cing*/ yul dang dbang po bden grub las rnam shes skye mig gis gzugs dngos su mthong zer ro/ /'di'i nang tshan kha che bye brag tu smra ba sogs grub mtha' bzang ba rnams ni/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig gis 'jig pas mi rtag par 'dod pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag ni blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs rdzas su med par 'dod/ mang pos bkur ba'i sde ba sogs grub mtha' ngan pa rnams ni/ 'dus byas rnams mthar 'jig pas mi rtag pa yin kyang*/ skad cig gis 'jig pa min zhes zer zhing de phyir rgyun gyi dngos po yang ci rigs par 'dod la/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis btags pa'i nga bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can de 'dra med kyang*/ spyir nga bdag tsam zhig rdzas grub dang bden grub tu 'dod/ 'di la bdag lta'i skyon gyis dngos su thar ba'i lam med na yang*/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song zhing*/ thar 'dod kyi kun nas bslangs pa'i tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum yod pas/ rim pas thar pa 'thob pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /bye brag tu smra ba 'di ni mngon pa sde bdun bkar 'dod cing*/ mdo sde rnams dgongs pa can dang*/ drang don gsungs pa mang bas/ lta grub rnams bstan bcos kyi lugs bzhin du khas len dgos par 'dod la/ bstan bcos kyang bye brag tu bshad pa la ngos 'dzin to// //mdo sde ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i chos de rnams las/ 'dus ma byas dang ldan min 'du byed ni btags yod ces bya ba blos btags pa tsam yin pas bden par med cing*/ gzugs sogs la rags rgyun dang shes pa la rgyun bden par ma grub/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi chos kyang btags yod tsam yin la/

da ltar ba'i rdul phran tsam dang shes pa skad cig ma tsam cha med bden grub yin/ mig gis gzugs mi mthong mig shes kyis kyang gzugs dngos su mi mthong ste/ mig shes kyis mthong ba de ni mig shes nyid la gzugs snang shar ba de gzugs kyi rnam par grags pa shes par gyur pa de yin la/ 'on kyang rnam pa 'char ba de la rnam pa gtod byed gzugs sogs phyi rol [ na ] yod par 'dod do/ /mngon pa sde bdun sogs ni bka' ma yin zhing*/ bye brag bshad pa sogs bstan bcos la 'khrul ba yod pas grub mtha' ni mdo sde dang bstun dgos par 'dod do/ /grub mtha' smra ba'i sde 'di gnyis kas kyang sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni/ nyan thos kyi ched du gsungs pa'i sde snod 'di rnams kho na yin zhing*/ sher phyin dkon brtsegs phal chen sogs theg chen gyi mdor grags pa 'di kun ni rgyal ba'i bka' ma yin no/ /theg pa che chung ni gang zag gi bya ba'i khyad par yin gyi gsung rab tha dad med do zhes zer ro/ /de rnams kyi gang bden grub tu 'dod pa de kun dang theg chen 'gog pa ni grub mtha' nor 'khrul gyi skyon yin la/ gang zag gi bdag med dang skad cig gis 'jig pa sogs gzhan rnams ni rang sa der ma nor ba yin no// //sems tsam pa ni/ gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi yul rnams rmi lam gyi gzugs sogs ltar shes pa nyid dang der snang ba tsam yin gyi/ phyi rol na de ltar snang ba med de dper na gzugs la mtshon na/ mig gi dbang por grags pa yang*/ mig g-i rnam par snang ba'i sems yin pas/ mig rang mtshan pa zhig med la/ gzugs su grags pa yang gzugs kyi rnam par snang ba'i sems yin pas gzugs rang mtshan pa med cing*/ de dag las mig gi rnam par shes pa skyes par snang ba tsam yin pas/ gsum kar yang tha dad par snang ba ni 'khrul ba yin zhing shes pa'i ngo bor rdzas gcig pas/ mig shes kyis gzugs mthong ba ni rang gis rang nyid mthong ba yin zhing*/

gzugs kyi rnam pa 'char ba'i rgyu shes pa las gzhan phyi rol tu rnam pa gtod byed gzugs su grub pa ni gtan nas med do/ /'on kyang ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i ngor mig gis gzugs mthong zhes sogs 'dod kyang dpyad na gzugs ni ma grub/ gzugs su snang ba'i shes pa de ni bden par grub bo/ /des na 'di ni rnam shes sogs shes pa thams cad kyi ngo bo bden par grub la/ yul phyi rol na yod pa ltar snang ba gzung cha dang*/ rig pa nang na yod pa ltar snang ba 'dzin cha ste de gnyis 'khrul ba yin pa'i phyir gzung 'dzin gnyis med la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs pa'i rnam par shes pa n-i bden par 'dod do/ /zhes 'dod pas gzung cha dang 'dzin cha gnyis tha dad du ma grub pas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi go chod pa dang*/ rnam shes kyi rang ngo tsam ye shes su 'dod pa yin no/ /sems tsam pa khong gi rang lugs kyi gzung 'dzin bkag par rlom yang grub mtha' gong mas gzhal na/ gzung 'dzin bkag par ma song ste gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med pa tsam zhig khas blangs pa yin kyang 'dzin pa rang ngos nas yod par khas blangs par song bas so/ /de ltar na 'dis 'dod pa'i gzugs sogs phyi don du snang ba'i rnam rig bden grub dang*/ rnam shes kyi ngo ldog tsam gzung 'dzin gnyis min gyi ye shes su 'dod pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i ngo bo rnam shes nyid la mi 'dod par yul du snang ba'i rnam rig las tha dad par snang ba'i cha tsam la 'dod pa ni 'khrul ba yin la gzhan rnams ma nor pa'o// //dbu ma pa la dbu ma phal pa dang*/ dbu ma chen po gnyis kyi phal pa ni bod yul 'dir rang stong du grags shing rgya bod gnyis kar du ngo bo nyid med par smra ba zhes grags pa ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang*/ legs ldan dang*/ rnam grol sde dang*/ zhi ba 'tsho rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams kyi lugs so/ /de dag la grub mtha' nang sel mi 'dra ba mang yang*/

thams cad mthun par gzugs sems gnyis dang ldan min 'du byed de 'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad dang*/ nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas dang dngos med thams cad de chos 'di dag thams cad ni kun rdzob yin la/ de rnams kyi rang bzhin bden med tsam ni don dam yin zhing*/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig dang tha dad gang du yang brjod du med/ rnam gzhag tsam tha dad de don dam dbyings kyi ngo bo ni gang yang med pas spros bral nam mkha'i dpes bstan/ kun rdzob snang dus na bden pas stong yang snang ba ma 'gag pa sgyu ma'i dpes bstan/ de gnyis kar yod med yin min sogs spros pa thams cad las 'das par 'dod do/ /grub mtha' 'di la yang don dam chos nyid de spros pa bkag tsam gyi nam mkha' lta bu la 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sogs kun rdzob yin zhing bden par med zer ba dang*/ don dam bden pa yang bden med du 'dod pa dang*/ khyad par thal 'gyur ba rnams ni grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'jog bzhin du/ gzhan gyi rtsod pa la 'dzem pa'i phyir gang yang khas mi len pa dang*/ nges shes ma skyes kyang log rtog zlog par 'dod pa sogs 'khrul ba yin la/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden par med pa dang*/ bden med tsam de yang bden par ma grub pa sogs ni ma nor ba yin no/ /sems tsam pa dang*/ rang stong smra ba'i dbu ma pa 'di gnyis kyi bde gshegs snying po'i nges gsang dang*/ don dam ye shes rang rig rang gsal ni rang lugs la mi 'dod cing de dag gi gnas tshul ma go bas/ slob dpon snga ma rnams kyis gzhan stong la dgag pa byas pa ni med la/ rjes 'brang phyis byung ba rnams kyis dgag pa byed mod kyang*/ gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i gnad go ba ni gcig kyang med pas phyogs snga ma longs pa'i dgag pa sha stag go/ //gnyis pa dbu ma chen po ni/ bod du gzhan stong du grags pa rnam rig gi dbu ma ste/

rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med dang*/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis gsal par mdzad cing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis chos dbyings bstod par yang ches gsal bas/ 'phags mchog gnyis car gyi bzhed pa gzhan stong yin no/ /'di'i lugs la sems tsam man chad du 'dod pa'i 'dus ma byas gsum sogs 'dus ma byas brtags pa ba dngos med rnams dang*/ gzugs sogs phyi don du grags pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig sogs mdor na gzhi phyi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ gnas skabs lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sas sdus pa'i nang nas gsar du byung ba'i cha rnams dang gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus pa ste/ snang grags kyi chos sam chos chos nyid kyi zlas phye ba'i chos sam gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos sam/ don dam gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs 'dir dngos po dngos med thams cad 'dus byas dang*/ glo bur bar gzhag pa de rnams thams cad ni bden med yin la/ dbyings dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang rig rang gsal ni don dam bden pa chos nyid 'dus ma byas zhes bya ba ste/ 'di ni rigs pas dpyad bzod bden grub kho na yin no/ /rang stong pa rnams 'dod pa'i nam mkha' lta bu de ni rnam par dpyad na dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa ma yin no zhes bzhed la/ grub mtha' 'di ni skyon med yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i grub mtha' 'o/ /theg chen pa de rnams thams cad theg chen gyi mdo thams cad bkar 'dod kyang*/ sems tsam pa rnams ni mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ rgyan stug po dang*/ phal po che ste mdo bzhir grags rnams nges don du 'dzin te/ gzhan rnams drang don du 'dod la/ grub mtha' byed pa po ni sngon gyi slob dpon lnga brgya po'o/ /dbu ma phal ba 'dzin pa rnams ni 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo thams cad drang don yin zhing*/

'khor lo bar pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo rnams nges don mthar thug go zhes smra/ grub mtha' byed pa po yin nges ni sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs gong du smos pa de rnams su zad la/ 'di rnams kyi rang rig gi 'dod pas sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogs ngo bo nyid med smra ba brgyad dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyang grub mtha' 'di kho na 'dzin pa yin no zhes 'dod do/ /dbu ma chen po ni 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi mdo mtha' dag la brten cing*/ khyab par du ka t+ya ya na'i gdams ngag gi mdo dang*/ mdo sde chen po stong pa nyid sogs 'khor lo dang po'i mdo mang po dang*/ byams pas zhus pa'i le'u dang sher phyin lnga brgya pa sogs 'khor lo bar ba'i gnas skabs mang po dang*/ mdo bzhi sogs tha ma'i mdo mang po la yang brten nas chos nyid don dam bden grub tu ston pa'i grub mtha' rags pa thun mong ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang*/ rnga bo che'i mdo dang*/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo dang*/ dpal phreng gi mdo dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang*/ dkon mchog sprin dang*/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul la sogs pa nges don mthar thug ston pa mang po la brten nas yang dag pa'i dbyings de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ chos kyi sku dang*/ rtag brtan g.yung drung dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan don dam pa thams cad gdod ma nas rang chas su bzhugs pa'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa zhib mo rnams gsang gtam du mdzad pa yin la/ mdo don gsal byed kyi gzhung byed pa po ni/ rgyal tshab 'phags pa byams pa yin te/ des mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan du chos skad rags pa de nyid mdo tsam du gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang*/ chos nyid rnam 'byed du gsal zhing rgyas par bshad/ snying po'i mdo'i don thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' zhib mo de rgyud bla mar gtan la phab bo/

/gzhung gi dgongs 'grel byed pa po ni thogs med sku mched de/ thogs med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel par/ thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' de shin tu rgyas shing gsal ba dang*/ spyir gzhan stong gi dbu ma ni sku mched gnyis kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag na gsal zhing dbyig gnyen gyi nyi khri'i 'grel pa gnod 'joms dang*/ chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa na shin tu gsal zhing rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan stong gi grub mtha' spyi de ni/ phyogs glang dang blo gros bstan pa la sogs pa'i slob ma slob rgyud mang la bzang ba rnams kyis rgya cher bshad cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa de ni gzhan gyi blor shong ba dka' nas slob ma mchog rnams la snyan nas snyan du brgyud tshul gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /phyis gzhan stong gi dbu ma 'di dang*/ sems tsam gyi grub mtha' 'dra 'dres su byas pa rgya gar du mang du byung ba la brten bod pa phal cher gyis gcig par 'khrul lo/ / bod du ni lo paṇa du mas gzhung rnams bsgyur kyang*/ grub mtha' gtsang mar 'dzin pa lo tsā ba gzu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang*/ btsan kha bo che sogs byams chos sgom lugs pa rnams yin zhing*/ khyad par du gzhan stong zab mo seng ge'i sgras sa steng khyab par mdzad pa po ni/ kun mkhyen chen po dol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /de lta bas na thams cad bshad/ / yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun rdzob bden pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ snang ba sna tshogs par 'char ba'i shes pa yang dag min rtog tsam ni kun rdzob tu yod la/ de la snang ba'i gzung cha dang 'dzin cha ni blos btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir kun rdzob tu yang yod pa ma yin no/

/des na kun rdzob bden pa yang mtha' gnyis las grol ba yin te/ kun rtog kun rdzob tu yod pa tsam khas blangs pas med mtha' dang chad mtha' las grol la/ gzung cha 'dzin cha sogs ltos chos sgro btags thams cad las 'das pas/ rtag mtha' dang yod mtha' las grol ba yin no/ /spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de ni/ rnam shes yang dag min rtog de la chos nyid kyi tshul du bden par yod cing*/ dri bcas kyi skabs na chos nyid de la rnam shes de chos can dri ma glo bur ba 'bral rung*/ spang bya dri ma bden med kyi ngo bor yod ces bya ste/ des na don dam bden pa yang mtha' gnyis dang bral ba zhes bya ste/ stong nyid bden grub dang*/ kun rtog sogs gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad bden med yin pa'i phyir/ yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa yin no/ /de lta bas na kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis ni 'khrul ba'i snang ba shar ba tsam ma gtogs rang gi ngo bos grub rgyu med pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos stong la/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i gzhan gyi ngo bor grub pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ rnam pa kun tu stong pas mi stong pa min la/ ye shes chos nyid de ni rang gi ngo bos gdod ma nas grub cing nam du yang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos stong pa ma yin zhing rtag tu yod pa'o/ /'o na mdo rnams su chos dbyings de yang stong par gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ spyir stong pa dang stong nyid yin kyang*/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa yin mi dgos te/ ye shes rang las gzhan gyi mtshan nyid can spros pa'am gzung 'dzin thams cad kyis stong pas stong nyid ces bya'o/ /de la kun brtags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub ste/ mtshan nyid gsum las kun btags ni nam mkha' la sogs pa dngos med thams cad dang*/ rnam rtog la shar ba'i gzugs sogs yul gyi snang cha rnams dang*/ ming la don du zhen pa dang don la ming du 'khrul ba'i ming don gyi 'brel ba dang*/

phyi nang mtha' dbus che chung bzang ngan mchog dus sogs blos sgro btags kyis gzung bya thams cad do/ /gzhan dbang ni gzung 'dzin gyi dngos por snang ba'i rnam par shes pa tsam ste/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas snang ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs grub ni rang rig rang gsal spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de yin te/ chos nyid dang chos dbyings dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ don dam bden pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /de la gzhan dbang dang kun brtags gnyis bden par med mnyam dang*/ 'khrul snang yin mnyam dang*/ kun rdzob dang rdzun pa yin mnyam yin kyang*/ mtshan nyid so sor dbye dgos pa ni/ kun brtags kun rdzob tu yang med/ gzhan dbang kun rdzob tu yod pa yin zhing*/ yongs grub ni kun rdzob tu med la don dam du yod pas bden par yod pa'o/ /de bzhin du kun brtags ni btags pas yod pa dang*/ gzhan dbang ni rdzas su yod pa dang*/ yongs grub ni de gnyis su yod pa min yang spros med du yod pa'o/ /kun brtags ni med pa'i stong nyid/ gzhan dbang ni yod pa'i stong nyid/ yongs grub ni don dam stong nyid do/ /rje btsun gyis/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing*/ /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang*/ /rang bzhin stong ba nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /kun brtags ni mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa/ gzhan dbang ni skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa/ yongs grub ni don dam ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /brten nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin med par bstan pa yin/ /'di'i lugs la shes bya thams cad la stong nyid kyis khyab pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid med pas khyab la/ des na

:chos thams cad stong nyid dang chos thams cad stong nyid med par khas len pa gzhan stong lugs yin gyi/ rang stong par grags pa'i lugs la nang 'gal yod do/ /des na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rang stong rnam dag ni kun rdzob rang stong du gnas pa 'di yin zhing*/ ngo bo nyid med pa yang gsum po 'di yin pas rang stong ma nor bar smra ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid med smra ba yin nges ni gzhan stong smra ba rnams yin la/ legs ldan dang*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs rang stong smra ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid med smra bar grags pa ni 'jig rten phal pa la grags pa gtso bor byas pa yin no/ /yongs grub bden grub tu yod na de la skye 'gag gnas gsum/ 'gro 'ong 'gyur ldog phyogs dus gcig dang du ma sogs yod dam zhe na ma yin te/ de rnams yod na bden med yin pas khyab cing*/ 'di ni skye med 'gag med gnas med/ 'gro med 'ong med/ gcig min du ma ma yin/ rgyu min 'bras min/ rang gi ngo bos mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum spangs pa/ phyogs dus thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gi ngo bos kun rdzob kyi chos nyid dang ma 'brel ba yin no/ /de la dum bu tha dad dbye rgyu med pa'i phyir cha med yin la/ chos nyid kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir kun 'gro dang kun khyab yin no// //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i don ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes de bzhin nyid dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo gcig cing de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'o zhes pa'i don te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang*/ bde gshegs snying po dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes pa rnams don gcig cing*/ de nyid sangs rgyas dang sems can sogs chos nyid la mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs kyang*/ sems can rnams la snying po'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing*/

sangs rgyas rnams la mngon sum gyi tshul du bzhugs pas/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid sems can gyi sems rgyud kyi dbus na snying por yod pa dang 'dra ba yin pas/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can zhes bya zhing*/ bde gshegs snying po de yang sems can la yod pa dang*/ sems can gyi de la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang khams zhes kyang bya'o/ /des na sangs rgyas la de bzhin nyid snying po'i tshul du bzhugs pa ma yin zhing*/ sems can gyi de snying po'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin pas de bzhin nyid gnyis su 'gyur ram snyam na/ mi 'gyur te sangs rgyas ni de bzhin nyid rang yin la sangs rgyas zhes pa skyes bu'i don can du 'chad kyang*/ rang nyid rang la ma sbas par mngon du gyur pa yin pas/ snying po'i don khong na gnas pa dang sbas pa la byas na/ khong na sbas pa'i snying po'i sgra bshad ma tshang la/ sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid de kho na sems can la gnas kyang sems can rang gi ngos nas ma mthong bas sems can la sbas pa'i don gyi snying po yin pas/ snying po'i don mi 'gyur ba la 'chad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi snying po can te/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni dngos po dang dngos med gnyis car las grol pas 'dus ma byas dngos don dam pa'i 'dus ma byas so/ /de yang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas lugs ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dbyings de sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi ngo bor yod pa la rtsod pa med la/ de ka sems can gyi chos dbyings dang dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po de yang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi ngo bor gnas pa la mi rigs pa ci zhig yod/ des na 'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/

/ces rgyud bla ma las gsungs te/'dus ma byas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gsungs pas/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad yod do/ /des na chos dbyings ye shes la don dam bden pa kho nas khyab la/ ye shes gzhan bzhi la gdod ma nas gnas pa'i don dam gtso che yang*/ lam bsgoms pas gsar thob kun rdzob kyi cha shas cung zad re yod cing*/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa yang de dang 'dra zhing mtshan dpe sogs sku'i yon tan dang*/ yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi yon tan la kun rdzob dang don dam ni cha mnyam zhing*/ de bzhin du ngo bo nyid sku don dam kho na dang*/ chos sku don dam shas che ba dang*/ longs sprul gnyis la dngos btags ma phye na cha mnyam zhing*/ 'phrin las kyang gzhan ngor snang ba ni kun rdzob yin la/ nus mthu'i ye shes ni don dam yin pas/ sku dang ye shes yon tan 'phrin las don dam gyis bsdus pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la gdod ma nas gnas pa yin la/ gang zag gcig sangs rgyas pa'i tshe de gsar thob ma yin zhing de la sgrib byed kyi dri ma bral ba tsam yin mod/ kun rdzob kyi de rnams ni gsar du thob pa yin no/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i de rnams ngo bo gcig cing*/ kun rdzob kyi de rnams kyang sangs rgyas thob pa phan chad nas ni rang bzhin [la ]dbye ba med la/ thob mtshams ni tha dad pa'i phyir gcig dang tha dad gang du yang mi brjod do/ /des na lam bsgoms pas bskyed rgyu 'bras bu gsar thob rnams ni skyed 'bras yin pas bden par med la/ gdod nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas ni lam bsgoms pa'i sangs rgyas de'i sgrib g.yogs bral ba tsam yin pas bral 'bras zhes bya zhing*/ lam yang de'i bral rgyu zhes rgyu 'bras btags pa tsam yin gyi dngos ma yin no/ /bral 'bras 'di yang mngon pa nas bshad pa'i/

bral ba blo yis zad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i so sor brtags 'gog ma yin gyi/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gdod nas zad pas de phyir zad ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don dam pa'i bral 'bras dang 'gog bden yin no/ /lam gyi mthus sgrib pa spangs pa yin pas blos zad pa dang don gcig par 'gyur ro snyam na/ sgrib pa ni chos dbyings ngos nas spangs pa ma yin gyi/ gang zag gi ngos nas spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgya mkhan gyi gang zag de nyid la blos zad pa'i bral ba thob bo zhes tha snyad tsam thob kyang*/ chos dbyings la gdod ma nas dri mas ma gos pa'i phyir blo yis gsar du zad pa ma yin no/ /des na chos nyid la mnyam pa nyid du khyab pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan don dam thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral yang ye shes kyi rnam pa kun ldan 'di nyid 'gyur med yongs grub chen po yin zhing*/ 'di kho na phyin ci ma log pa'i gnas lugs dang*/ 'phags pa'i ye shes ma 'khrul ba'i myong bya yin pa'i phyir bden par grub la 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag brtan ther zug go/ bde gshegs snying po mtshan dpe sogs yon tan can du bzhugs pa 'di gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag las rnam grangs du mas gsungs so/ /kun rdzob ces kyang bya gzung 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ 'khrul ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba mdor na snang grags kyi chos gang gis kyang yongs grub de la ma gos shing*/ ma gos pa de yang kun rdzob de dngos gnas la yod kyang chos dbyings la gos ma thub par so sor tha dad na yod pa ma yin gyi/ kun rdzob ni 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam yin pas/ gnas lugs la ri bong rwa bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir gos rgyu med nas ma gos pa yin no/ /des na yongs grub bde gshegs snying po de ni rang gi ngo bos nam yang mi stong la/

gzhan kun rdzob kyis gdod nas stongs pa'i phyir/ yongs grub don dam bden pa de ni gzhan stong yin gyi rang stong min no/ /de'i phyir kun rdzob rnams gzhan gyi ngo bos stong pa'i steng du rang gi ngo bos kyang stong pa dang don dam gzhan gyi ngo bo kho nas stong ba'i phyir tshul 'di smra ba ni gzhan stong dbu ma'o/ /de la 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa ci rigs pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyis nges 'byung bsgom pa dang*/ rang don yid byed spong zhing byang chub kyi sems rgyud la bsten par bya/ kun rdzob la zhen pa rags pa rnams spangs ba'i phyir kun rdzob bden med du gtan la phab nas bsgom/ zhen pa phra bo rnams kyang spong ba'i phyir kun rdzob kyi rnam rtog dbyings su bsdus nas mi rtog pa bsgom/ des bde gshegs snying po mi rtog pa dang rim pas zhal mjal bar 'gyur bas/ lam bsgom tshad yongs grub dang mjal ba'i phyir yin no// gsum pa gzhan gyis brtags pa'i mtha' bsal ba ni/ gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan du yang shes par bya la/ rgyas par gzhan du 'chad par yang 'gyur mod/ snying po bsdus pa ni/ gzhan dag laṅkar gshegs pa las/ bde gshegs snying po mtshan dpe can yod na mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba min nam zhes zhus nas/ lan du m-i mtshungs te stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pas/ bde gshegs snying po bden med yin zhing*/ mtshan dpe sogs yod na mu stegs pa'i lugs su 'gyur pas/ nam mkha' ltar cir yang ma grub pa zhig la bde gshegs snying po zhes bya'o/ /zhes zer ba ni stong nyid yin tshad bden med kyi don dang*/ rnam med cir yang ma grub pa tsam la ngos 'dzin pa rang gi grub mtha' ngan pa la zhen pa'i blo skyon yin zhing*/ mdo las kyang*/ mu stegs dang mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan stong nyid yin par bkod kyi mtshan dpe med pa ma bkod pa'i phyir/

mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bde gshegs snying po drang don du bshad zer ba yang rdzun gyi 'jig rten bslu ba tsam du zad do/ /yang snying po rtag par 'dod pa mu stegs kyi lugs so zer ba yang snying po'i mdo rnams la dgag pa byed par zad la/ rtag pa'i don rgyun gyi rtag pa la 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ rgyun gyi rtag pa tsam ni 'khor ba dang gzung 'dzin kun kyang yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyun gyi rtag pa tsam gyis rtag pa'i go chod na 'dus byas thams cad kyang rtag par 'gyur ro/ /dang po dri bcas yin pa phyis dri med du 'gyur bas mi rtag pa yin no snyam na/ chos dbyings kyi ngos nas dang po dri bcas ma yin la/ phyis dri med du song ba yang ma yin mod/ dri bcas dang dri med du 'gro tshul ni gang zag gi rgyud la bltos nas yin pa'i phyir/ sems can gnas skabs 'gyur bas chos nyid gnas skabs 'gyur bar mi 'gro'o/ /sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yod pa ni mi 'thad do snyam na/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /zhes dngos su gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yod pa mi 'thad de/ dper mtshon na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs sems can gyi rgyud la yod na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa thams cad sems can gyi shes par thal lo zhes zer pa yang yang dag pa ma yin te/ sems can gyi rgyud yin tshad sangs rgyas yin no zhes kho bo cag ni mi 'dod pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas dang de'i yon tan bzhugs pas der thal na/ gdan khri la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa na/ gdan khris kyang shes bya thams cad shes par thal bar 'gyur ram/ des na sems can gyi rgyud rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad sangs rgyas ga la yin zhing*/ de la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang kun rdzob rten brten pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ma yin la/

don dam chos nyid kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa yin no/ / skabs 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i brda chad cung zad brjod na/ chos 'khor rim pa gsum ni/ dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor ro/ /dang po nyan thos la gsungs pa'i sde snod theg dman gyi mdo/ bar ba theg chen gyi rtsa ba'i mdo lta bu yin yang dgongs don gab par yod/ tha ma ni de'i bshad rgyud lta bu ste nges don shin tu gsal bar bstan to/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum las/ kun brtags la gzung ba'i kun brtags dang 'dzin pa'i kun brtags gnyis/ gzhan dbang la ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang dang dag pa'i gzhan dbang gnyis/ yongs grub la 'gyur med yongs grub dang phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis yod pa las/ kun brtags dngos gzung ba dang*/ yongs grub dngos 'gyur med yin la/ 'gyur med dang ngo bo gcig pa'i phyin ci ma log pa cig yod pa de min phyin ci ma log pa dag pa gzhan dbang du bsdu/ 'dzin pa kun brtags dang gzhan dbang ngo bo gcig go /rigs pas rnam par dpyad pa'i tshe gzhan dbang dngos ni kun brtags su 'du zhing*/ de'i chos nyid kyi gnas tshul ni yongs grub yin pas/ kun brtags dang yongs grub gnyis su chos thams cad 'dus so/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la mtshan nyid gsum gyi dbye ba'am/ kun rdzob rnam shes dang 'brel ba dang*/ don dam ye shes kyi phyogs gnyis gnyis bzhag nas/ gzugs sgra dri ro sogs kun rdzob rnam shes kyi phyogs yin pa'i phyir bden med dang*/ chos nyid kyi gzugs sgra sogs ye shes kyi phyogs yin pas bden grub dang*/ kun rdzob kyi phyogs tha dad dang*/ don dam gyi chos rnams 'gal 'dus skyon med do/ /zhes pa 'di yang don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ chos lung byang rtse'i dben gnas su'o//
//bkra shis/ gcig zhus// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gzhan stong snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 168 -- PAGE 169 -- PAGE 162 -
